# Speech fixture

fleurs_ru_1.wav and its reference transcript were imported from OwlWhisp commit
de8a822d8d5d28bb21018a78f5e93e59fd34a24b, tests/fixtures/audio.

Original source: google/fleurs, ru_ru dev, 2185040307306545167.wav.
FLEURS (Conneau et al., 2022), https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs.
License: CC-BY-4.0.

This short real-speech fixture checks native inference and Russian text. It does not establish
general recognition quality or phone performance. It is included only in Android debug assets.
